items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: So, I'd sit in with them several times... I had a lot of fun playing with them

ctx.x: and they had a band there. It was called St. Emma's School, Rock Castle, Virginia, about 40 miles out of Richmond, Virginia. I went there in '26.

In the summers I started in -- started playing in the band around this school. In the summers I would go around Richmond which was 40 miles away. And at that time around Richmond there was a band that was kind of popular, Johnson's Happy Pals. And Roy Johnson and a bunch of them had this band together. They played a lot of blues, and they played a lot of other things. They played dances around there.
So, I'd sit in with them several times. I didn't know too much about what I was doing but I had a lot of fun playing with them, you know, and I learned a lot, you know, around guys like this.
